name: chavajs
description: chavaJs — a Laravel-equivalent full-stack framework for Node.js. React + Inertia + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + Motion on the front, a Laravel-style container/router/middleware stack on the back.

scripts.publish:core: npm run build:core && npm publish ./dist/@chavajs/core --access public
scripts.publish:cli: npm run build:cli && npm publish ./dist/@chavajs/cli --access public
scripts.publish:installer: npm run build:installer && npm publish ./dist/@chavajs/installer --access public
scripts.publish:all: npm run publish:core && npm run publish:cli && npm run publish:installer
scripts.test: npm test --prefix examples/starter && npm test --prefix packages/installer && npm test --prefix packages/permissions
